chain_title: Idea ≠ trigger - check chain per item
chain_empty: No items yet - submit one or press Run now.
seat_ai_title: Assign an AI (or rules) to each seat
seat_ai_hint: AI can only make a seat more cautious: it may add a block, never remove one. Failures abstain and the rules decide.
saved: Saved - applies on the next cycle
cli_nokeys: No API keys found. Add keys to .env or run with rules only.
prof_hint: Edit any parameter below, then Apply, or save it as a named profile you can reload or share. API keys are never stored in profiles.
confirm_reset: Reset every setting of this workflow to the defaults?
export_hint: Send the file or the share code to anyone using SeatCrew. API keys and secrets are removed automatically.
author: author (optional)
import_hint: Choose a .seatcrew.json file or paste a share file / share code, then check the preview.
data_hint: Where settings, profiles, history and keys are stored on this computer.
data_env_locked: Set by the SEATCREW_DATA_DIR environment variable - change it there.
tagline: every item walks the check chain
simple_hint: Simple mode hides advanced parameters (prompts, models, limits). Turn off to see everything.
who_hint: CHIEF assigns, seats judge, checks gate, a human approves.
who_1d: Starts each cycle and hands items to the seats. Never approves on its own.
who_2d: Each seat checks one thing: rules first, then its AI (if any). AI can only be more cautious.
who_3d: One BLOCKED check stops the item with a reason. Nothing slips past.
who_4d: A human seat waits for your Approve / Reject
who_4n: No human gate here: items that pass every check finish automatically.
help_chief: the commander: starts cycles and assigns work.
help_check: a check: passes or BLOCKS the item (rules + optional AI).
help_human: a human gate: the item waits for your Approve / Reject.
help_producer: a producer: writes something (e.g. a draft), then the next seats check it.
